WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Any random word (letters, numbers, `_` and `-` only). Blocks fake requests to your bot. Recommended. `none` to skip.

CHANNEL_ID.description: Optional. Channel users must join first, e.g. `@mychannel`. Add your bot as **admin** there. `none` to skip.

CHANNEL_LINK.description: Optional. Join link, e.g. `https://t.me/mychannel`. `none` to build it from `CHANNEL_ID`.

CHANNEL_BUTTON_TEXT.description: Optional. Join button label, e.g. `✨ Join My Channel`. `none` for default.

WELCOME_EXTRA.description: Optional. Extra text under the /start message. Telegram HTML allowed, `\n` for new line. `none` to skip.
